ImageDescription.value: : Miracle Stag Legend Fountain by János Németh and Károly Szerdahelyi (2000 ceramic relief 'wall' and mosaic covered pool). relief about the Legend of the Miracle Stag. At the center of the relief is the miracle deer itself, with its head down, just sipping from the cooling water. Above it, the sundial that shifts to the crescent shines. Between the branches of the deer's antlers, a star shines. The deer's hideout is surrounded by the trees of the forest, between them lying on the ground the legendary brother and sister, Hunor and Magor. The two horses graze. A small bird chirp on the tree. The drinking deer carries the entire cosmos, and thus its symbolic meaning is the tree of life. At the two ends of the relief a tumulus and a galley (ship) referring to the former Roman port of Százhalombatta/Matrica. - Szent István Square, City Center, Újváros neighborhood, Százhalombatta, Pest County, Hungary.
